parks.name: Assateague Island National Seashore
parks.blurb: Barrier island beach; wild horses, ghost crabs, shorebirds and deer.

parks.name: Blackwater National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Chesapeake marsh; bald eagles, Delmarva fox squirrels, ducks and turtles.

parks.name: Patapsco Valley State Park
parks.blurb: River valley forest near Baltimore; deer, owls, hawks and salamanders.

parks.name: Rocky Gap State Park
parks.blurb: Mountain lake and forest; deer, black bears, ospreys and turtles.

parks.name: Calvert Cliffs State Park
parks.blurb: Fossil cliffs on the Chesapeake; shark teeth, ospreys, turtles and salamanders.

parks.name: Point Lookout State Park
parks.blurb: Where the Potomac meets the bay; ospreys, horseshoe crabs, dolphins and herons.

parks.name: Patuxent Research Refuge
parks.blurb: Forest and meadows; whooping cranes, bald eagles, wild turkeys and deer.

parks.name: Cunningham Falls State Park
parks.blurb: Waterfall and mountain forest; deer, salamanders, owls and black bears.

parks.name: Deep Creek Lake State Park
parks.blurb: Mountain lake and woods; black bears, deer, ospreys and turtles.

parks.name: Eastern Neck National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Chesapeake island; tundra swans, bald eagles, ducks and Delmarva fox squirrels.

parks.name: Druid Hill Park
parks.blurb: Baltimore city park; deer, ducks, hawks and squirrels.
